d: Provide high-quality, practical and commercially focused legal advice and support across OQ8's business activities to protect the Company's interests and ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, contractual obligations and governance requirements.

The Legal Counsel supports OQ8's strategic and operational objectives by identifying and mitigating legal risks, drafting and negotiating complex agreements, advising on corporate, commercial, financing and project matters, managing disputes and claims, supporting corporate governance activities, and coordinating with external legal counsel where required.
q: Master or any other additional qualification (additional not necessary)
Legal Counsel: 10 years+ of relevant experience in Oil & Gas- Downstream/Commercial experience ideally both internationally and Local, including private legal practice.
Or Legal Associate: 8 years+ of relevant experience.
Experience and qualified in Oman law
Excellent drafting skills and exposure to legal framework
In-house and/or Law firm experience is required.
Models and ensures commitment with business aspirations, ethics & guidelines
Maintaining effective, accurate, and transparent communication with all stakeholders & community
Transforms strategic insight into achieving business excellence
Excellent business and technical report writing skills. Specialist in legal
Project Finance and lender related matters
r: Coordinate and execute legal support regarding processes and procedures to assure legal compliance of OQ8 associated with all business matters and activities and provide legal advice, guidance, thoughts, and insights associated with day to day activities.
Furnish accurate and timely Legal advice for OQ8’s the specific area (Contracts, Finance, Commercial Corporate or Projects).
Specifying internal governance requirements and regular advice on compliance related matters. .
Collaborating with business units & management to devise efficient legal risk strategies.
Communicate and negotiate with external parties (regulators, external counsel, public authority etc.),
Draft and negotiate project agreements, contracts and other legal documents with OQ8 interest in mind
Deal with the relevant project complex matters with multiple stakeholders.
Provide legal advice and support on corporate, commercial, project, finance, procurement and operational matters.
Identify, assess and mitigate legal risks associated with business activities and strategic initiatives.
Monitor legal and regulatory developments and advise on potential business impacts.
Obtaining & oversees the work of external counsels,
Develops and maintains a Compliance program that reinforces behaviors within defined and communicated boundaries
Draft, review, negotiate and advise contracts on a broad range of commercial agreements and legal documentation.
Support procurement, project, financing and operational teams in contract negotiations.
Advising the operative units on compliance issues arising from regulatory offences (e.g. logistics, working hours, loaned employees, occupational safety, environmental issues, etc.).

Spatial and temporal readiness for the legal support of investigation measures of various authorities (customs authorities, police, local government, municipality, community, public prosecutor's office, etc.).
Provide guidance about the impact of proposed or passed legislation that affects OQ8's business activities.
Manage pre-dispute matters, claims and contentious issues to protect OQ8's legal and commercial interests.
Support Head of Legal on the development and execution of the Corporate Legal and Compliance long-term plan in alignment with the function and organization strategies.

Report progress of Corporate Legal, Corporate and the department business plans, opportunities, challenges and issues faced, mitigations taken and course correction actions, etc. as required, to make an informed decision.
Document all the legal cases to support OQ8 in dealing with eventual legal disputes
Advice and settlement of extrajudicial proceedings.
Preparation, revision, and review of employment contracts, employment regulations, and other personnel-related documents, taking into account the current legal situation and case law.
Accompanying and conducting negotiations on company agreements, developing corresponding draft templates, and conducting the corresponding negotiations.
Drafting, revision, and negotiation of rental and lease agreements of any kind.
Maintenance and administration of the local land register, documents, contracts, and agreements.
Review and advice contracts with local and international suppliers (e.g. Contracts for purchasing of equipment, catalyst, technical gases, etc.)

d: Join Qiddiya to manage City Operations assets as they transition from delivery into live operations. You will coordinate readiness planning, mobilisation, training and handover evidence, identifying gaps early and helping receiving teams prepare for a controlled operational transition.
q: Degree in facilities management, engineering, construction management, asset management, operations management or a related discipline.

Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in facilities management, asset operations, operational readiness or project-to-operations transition, including at least 2 years managing or coordinating readiness, mobilisation or handover workstreams.
Practical experience preparing new properties, public realm, infrastructure or mixed-use assets for operational handover, coordinating delivery teams, technical specialists and receiving operators.
Experience maintaining readiness plans, verifying evidence, tracking defects and dependencies, escalating blockers and supporting transition into live operations.
Relevant recognised certification in facilities management, asset management or project management is preferred.
Training in operational readiness, commissioning and handover, or health and safety is advantageous.
r: Develop asset-level readiness plans aligned with delivery milestones, phased handovers and opening dates, tracking dependencies, owners and completion evidence.
Coordinate operational design reviews covering access, maintainability, cleanability, service routes, storage and operational support needs.
Confirm service boundaries, operating responsibilities and interfaces, escalating ownership gaps and unresolved dependencies.
Coordinate mobilisation of service providers, staffing, equipment, consumables, procedures and support facilities.
Track handover documentation and coordinate asset-data, CAFM workflow and planned-maintenance readiness with responsible specialists.
Arrange training, operational walkthroughs, scenario-based trials and joint inspections, tracking corrective actions and closure evidence.
Maintain readiness registers, risk logs and evidence packs, providing recommendations for handover and opening gates without assuming technical certification or final acceptance authority.
Transfer readiness records, outstanding actions and approved interim arrangements to receiving teams, supporting initial operational stabilisation.

d: Chef Middle East is looking for an experienced Sales Executive to join our Sales team in Doha, Qatar. We are looking for a proactive and commercially driven professional with a strong foodservice background, established HORECA relationships and the ability to independently manage and grow an existing customer portfolio.
q: 2–3 years of relevant foodservice sales experience in Qatar, preferably with a food distributor.
Established customer relationships within the HORECA sector.
Proven track record of achieving sales targets and developing new business.
Strong commercial, negotiation and relationship management skills.
Good understanding of margins, pricing and payment terms.
Experience managing collections and overdue payments.
Fluent in English; Arabic would be an advantage.
r: Manage and develop an existing portfolio of foodservice customers across hotels, restaurants and catering.
Drive sales growth, achieve sales and gross profit margin targets, and increase product penetration across multiple food categories.
Identify new business opportunities and develop existing customer relationships.
Manage customer pricing, negotiations, collections and outstanding payments in coordination with the relevant internal teams.
Monitor sales performance, analyse business opportunities and maintain accurate sales forecasts and CRM updates.
Conduct regular customer visits, follow up on opportunities and ensure excellent customer service.
Work closely with internal departments to support customer requirements and resolve operational challenges.
